title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

E agora buscamos alguém que venha construir isso junto.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


SUA MISSÃO:

A pessoa coordenadora atua como uma ponte entre a estratégia macro e a execução, garantindo que os times de Product Owners/Managers, Frontend e Backend tenham os recursos, a orientação e o ambiente necessários para entregar valor constante ao negócio.

Seu principal foco será o desenvolvimento de talentos, excelência operacional e entrega tática.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

• Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe, realizando 1:1s, planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e avaliações de desempenho.

• Alinhamento Tático: Garantir que as squads sob sua coordenação estejam alinhadas com os

OKRs da área e que as dependências entre times sejam gerenciadas com eficiência.

• Refinamento de Processos: Implementar e otimizar metodologias de discovery e delivery, garantindo agilidade e qualidade sem burocracia excessiva.

• Interface com Stakeholders: Atuar como ponto de apoio para áreas parceiras (Vendas, CX,

Engenharia), traduzindo prioridades e gerenciando expectativas de curto e médio prazo.

• Suporte ao Discovery: Apoiar o time na validação de hipóteses e na construção de roadmaps realistas e baseados em dados.


O QUE ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ SAIBA:

• Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor; domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); conhecimento em métricas de produto (NPS, Churn, LTV, conversão); experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Notion, etc.).

• Liderança servidora, habilidade em resolução de conflitos, comunicação clara e assertiva, capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks construtivos e organização multitarefa.

• Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação para backend nas linguagens Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP.

• Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL

Server).

Conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento de APis REST.

• Domínio de um framework (React, Vue, Angular) e seu ecossistema.

• Profundo conhecimento em gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Vuex, Zustand, etc.).

• Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack, Vite) e pré-processadores

(SASS).

• Habilidade em criar e manter testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).

• ¡OS Nativo (Swift):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, VIPER).

• Profundo conhecimento em SwiftUl e/ou UIKit para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods) e concorrência (GCD, Swift Concurrency).

• Android Nativo (Kotlin):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, MVI) e dos componentes Jetpack.

• Profundo conhecimento em Jetpack Compose e/ou XML para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com Coroutines/Flow para programação assíncrona e Dagger/Hilt para injeção de dependência.

• Flutter (Dart):

• Domínio de padrões de gerenciamento de estado avançados (BLoC, Riverpod).

• Habilidade em criar widgets customizados e complexos.

• Experiência com canais de plataforma (platform channels) para integração com código nativo.

• Mentalidade Orientada a Dados: Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.

• Empatia pelo Cliente: Um desejo profundo de entender e resolver os problemas dos usuários.

• Espírito Colaborativo: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe com desenvolvedores, designers, marketing e outras áreas.

• Resiliência e Adaptação: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes de incerteza e mudar de curso

quando necessário.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor
description:
Position: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

Responsibilities:

  • Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code following best development practices.
  • Create website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML/CSS standards.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Develop back-end services using Node.js.
  • Work with other programming languages as required.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to projects.
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure visual design alignment.
  • Preferred: experience with mobile development (iOS/Android) or React Native.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Solid experience in Javascript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong programming skills and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.
  • Understanding of web application functionality, including security and best practices.
  • Proven track record in web programming.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, object-oriented programming, and web application development.
  • Problem-solving and creative diagnosis skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Haves / Differentials:

  • Experience with Web3, MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
  • Mobile app development and integration with hardware SDKs, drones, or sensors.
  • Experience with prototyping, algorithms, R&D, QA, and software quality assurance.

Contract Details:

  • Contractor will work under a service agreement (PJ/Freelancer).
  • Contractor will issue monthly invoices for services rendered.
  • No employment relationship (CLT), and no employment benefits (transportation, vacation, 13th salary, etc.) are provided.
  • Flexible hours and autonomy in executing tasks, while meeting project deadlines and deliverables.

Keywords: Javascript, React, Node.js, MERN Stack, MongoDB, Express, Front-end, Back-end, Mobile (iOS/Android), React Native, Web Development, Software Development, R&D, Prototyping, QA, Algorithms, Engineering, Technology.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


O ano de 2025 foi ótimo para nós, crescemos 155% e mais que dobramos nosso time de operações!


Buscamos novas pessoas para nosso time de recrutamento que queiram fazer parte desse crescimento acelerado:


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 4.500 – 12.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$6.500 - 9.000), sem teto.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses

title: Data Architect (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 6 years of experience as a Data Engineer
  • Strong experience in Data Architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
  • Experience with Big Data tools and technologies, including Databricks
  • Solid experience with ETL processes and data integration via APIs
  • Experience across the full lifecycle: implementation, development, and maintenance
  • English level B2 or higher
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid, based in Portugal.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system, PureScore, continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a highly skilled Sr. Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team. This is a full-stack role with a primary emphasis on backend engineering. You will be responsible for architecting, developing, and maintaining the core services, scalable RESTful APIs, and cloud infrastructure that power our mobile application. In addition to infrastructure and API design, you will optimize database interactions to ensure high performance. This is a fast-paced role within our global organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Your Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, robust RESTful API endpoints using .NET Core to support high-volume data consumption.
  • Design and optimize database structures using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance and data integrity.
  • Implement and maintain server-side logic, integrating with third-party services using C# and object-oriented design principles.
  • Deploy and maintain scalable cloud solutions on AWS, specifically utilizing EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Test drive development and write comprehensive Unit/Integration tests to ensure code quality and stability.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD, and cloud deployments to ensure efficient release cycles.
  • Implement new features in our mobile app using Flutter.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORMs like Entity Framework.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and deep understanding of MVC design patterns.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases with a preference for MySQL, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Knowledge of JSON, HTML, YAML, REST standards, and Git version control.
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab).
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line interface operations.

title: Azure / Windows Architect
description:
Job Title: Azure/Windows Architect

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


Key responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure migrations: Conduct on‑prem/public cloud infra assessments using Azure Migrate and drive solutioning for large, complex Azure migrations.
  • Design landing zones: Understand customer infra landscape; design and build Azure Landing Zones aligned to business, application, and infrastructure strategies.
  • Architect & document: Provide Azure target architecture (HLD/LLD), BoM pricing, licensing details, and clear TCO/ROI rationale.
  • Migrate & troubleshoot: Migrate on‑prem workloads to Azure; troubleshoot Azure/Windows issues across processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory.
  • Define end‑to‑end solutions: Realize solution architecture addressing business processes, regulatory needs, quality attributes, and cost efficiency.
  • Windows services expertise: Administer and troubleshoot Windows File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; perform upgrades, backups, and restorations.
  • Team leadership: Govern and technically guide infra teams (5+ members); provide 24×7 support and work in shifts.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with internal/customer stakeholders and PMs across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains; ensure risks are mitigated and lessons captured post‑project.


Must have skills:

  • Experience: 13+ years in IT; 5+ years in Azure Infra, Azure Migrate, Azure Networking (IaaS/PaaS), DC/Cloud/Security/SIAM/Data/Storage.
  • Azure services: Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM, Landing Zone design, BoM/pricing/licensing, TCO/ROI.
  • Windows administration: File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; server consolidation, upgrades, backup/restore.
  • Migration & troubleshooting: On‑prem to Azure via Azure Migrate; deep troubleshooting in Azure & Windows environments.
  • Leadership & support: Team governance (5+), stakeholder management, 24×7 support readiness, shift flexibility.


Good to have:

  • Certifications: AZ‑305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ‑104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator).
  • Design exposure: DR/business continuity, identity/governance/monitoring solutions; solution presentations and customer communication.


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager – NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Position : Front End (React) Developer

Years of exp: 4 + Years in React

Location : Remote ( Brazil )

Duration : 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)

work time : Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST


Role Overview


You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Evaluation Process


  • Technical Interview with live coding challenge focused on React(60 mins)

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Gerente de Vendas de Área(Neurocirurgia)
description:
Anúncio de Vaga - Gerente de Vendas de Área / Gerente de Vendas de Produto


O candidato ideal terá histórico comprovado em vendas de dispositivos médicos, especificamente em neurocirurgia, tecnologias de coluna vertebral ou craniana, e possuirá relacionamentos sólidos com os principais stakeholders em hospitais e centros cirúrgicos.

Localização : Brasil


Requisitos

  • Graduação em administração de empresas, ciências da vida ou área correlata (MBA será um diferencial).
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em vendas de dispositivos médicos, com no mínimo 3 anos em neurocirurgia/coluna vertebral/neurovascular.
  • Sucesso comprovado no mercado local; rede de clientes existente é preferível.
  • Fluência no idioma local e em inglês.
  • Excelentes habilidades de negociação, apresentação e construção de relacionamentos.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens com mais de 50% de frequência dentro da região.

Nossas Ofertas

  • Salário competitivo + bônus baseados em desempenho.
  • Crescimento de carreira em uma empresa global de tecnologia médica.
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com produtos inovadores.

title: Automation Specialist - Especialista Senior
description:
Breve Descrição:

Responsável pela identificação conjunta de oportunidades relacionadas a automação e IA de atividades e processos operacionais do atendimento digital, por realizar a governança e curadoria das automações implementadas, bem como a responsabilidade de contribuir com o desenvolvimento de novas soluções de automação/IA personalizadas e/ou prontas para uso alinhadas à evolução do negócio junto ao time de infraestrutura de TI.


Principais atividades:

  • Elaborar o roadmap evolutivo do atendimento digital, considerando a estratégia de negócio e o contexto tecnológico, incluindo a evolução de soluções digitais e iniciativas com agentes de IA.;
  • Estabelecer padrões para soluções para o atendimento digital por meio de contribuições para a criação e manutenção da arquitetura de referência aplicacional, funcional e técnica, garantindo governança e aderência corporativa.
  • Apoiar equipes de negócio e equipes técnicas no direcionamento de soluções para o atendimento digital, contribuindo para decisões arquiteturais em novos projetos ou necessidades evolutivas do atendimento digital.
  • Manter a visão de futuro do atendimento digital, identificando e avaliando gaps da arquitetura atual e propondo melhorias.
  • Buscar e propor oportunidades de evolução do atendimento digital ou adoção de novas práticas tecnológicas, por meio de estudos e prospecção de mercado em Telecom e Digital.
  • Coordenar ou executar a evolução da arquitetura existente utilizando melhores práticas, ferramentas emergentes e alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas.
  • Prospectar e avaliar evoluções aplicacionais em trabalho conjunto com grupos multidisciplinares.
  • Relacionar-se com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos, garantindo alinhamento técnico entre arquitetura, digital e negócio.
  • Participar de PoCs para validar implementações, incluindo componentes aplicacionais e funcionalidades emergentes relacionadas à automação e IA no atendimento digital.


Experiência, conhecimentos e formação:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura de Software, Engenharia de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou Transformação Digital.
  • Experiência sólida na elaboração e manutenção de arquiteturas de referência corporativas, com foco aplicacional e funcional.
  • Vivência em definição de padrões arquiteturais, governança técnica e alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Experiência em apoiar múltiplas equipes na definição de soluções, avaliando requisitos, gaps e riscos tecnológicos.
  • Histórico na evolução de arquiteturas corporativas, propondo melhorias com base em práticas de mercado e tendências tecnológicas.
  • Atuação colaborativa com times multidisciplinares, contribuindo para decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Participação em PoCs e validação de soluções em cenários complexos.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte, preferencialmente com exposição a iniciativas digitais e aplicações de média/alta complexidade

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer for a 100% Remote, 6 month +, 1099 contract


No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV to lead technical initiatives, tackle complex engineering challenges, and provide mentorship to the team. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.


In This Role You Will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements
  • Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development
  • Contribute to system architecture and design discussions


Core Competencies for success:

  • Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
  • Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation


Requirements:

  • Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js
  • Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions
  • Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices
  • Experience leading teams and managing software projects

title: React Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a React Developer to join our Reinforcement Learning (RL) Gym project. You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Important Notes for Submission

  • Kindly prioritize candidates with immediate availability and confirm their commitment to 8 - 4 hrs/day with PST overlap.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico.


Evaluation Process

  • Candidates complete Interest Check Form (ICF)
  • Shortlisted candidates only will be invited for MTI

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Performance Static Designer
description:
ReciMe is a recipe app revolutionizing how cooks organize, plan and shop their recipes. Our smart importing tool enables users to aggregate all their recipes in one platform within seconds - whether those recipes came from an Instagram video, recipe blog or grandma’s recipe box.


We’ve been a Top 10 app in the US App Store’s Food category for months and were recently featured on The Drew Barrymore Show.


Now, we’re looking for a Performance Static Designer to join our team!


You’ll be responsible for creating static and carousel ads for Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok and Pinterest.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team to adapt content for different platforms, test variations, and bring ad concepts to life. Your designs will play a key role in driving engagement, conversions, and brand growth.

title: \"Analista DevOps SR#984930\"
description:
A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente do ramo do varejo.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em práticas DevSecOps e metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em construção de pipelines (Azure DevOps);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração CI/CD (Azure DevOps);
  • Experiência com sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows;
  • Experiência com sistemas containers;
  • Experiência em ferramentas e boas-práticas de infraestrutura como código (Terraform e Helm);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Github, Gitlab, entre outras);
  • Experiência com administração e provisionamento de recursos em nuvem pública (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality/Quality Gate como SonarCloud, Snyk, Gitleaks ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de integrações via API;
  • Conhecimento da ferramenta Backstage;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação ou ferramentas de automação;
  • Conhecimento em processo de automação de testes;


Atuação 100% remoto - Brasil

Contratação CLT

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Professional Services Technician
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como especialista em Serviços Profissionais na Lynx Financial Crime Tech, com uma posição baseada no Brasil, em modelo remoto, em colaboração com o time global de Serviços Profissionais em Madrid (Espanha) e com foco em clientes no Brasil e em outros países da América Latina.


A Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A, é uma empresa de software baseado em IA, especializada em detectar e prever padrões de comportamento. Liderados por uma equipe experiente do setor financeiro e acadêmico, desenvolvemos e implementamos tecnologias de IA de ponta e autoaprendizado. Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.


O que você vai fazer

Como Professional Services Technician, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.


✅ O que buscamos em você

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

Conhecimentos de Linux – nível usuário.

Espanhol avançado;

Conhecimento em Fraude e/ou Lavagem de Dinheiro;

Capacidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Boas habilidades de comunicação;

Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança.


Seguinte passo

Candidate-se e se você conhece alguém que possa estar procurando por essa oportunidade, compartilhe.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer | Remote | Brazil | $30-$35 per hour | 12 months


Role: Platform Engineer

Location: Remote (Candidate must be based in Brazil)

Rate / Salary: $30-$35 per hour

Duration: 12 months (extension likely)

Language: English


I'm partnering with a leading consultancy delivering a large-scale Cloud, DevOps & Data transformation for a major global organisation in the aviation sector.


We are looking for a Platform Engineer with a strong software development background to support the next phase of the programme. This initiative focuses on building a high-availability, globally distributed platform, modernising infrastructure, improving automation, and raising operational reliability standards across mission-critical aviation systems.


Skills & Responsibilities:


  • Strong software engineering background with current hands-on focus in DevOps / Platform Engineering roles.
  • Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Jenkins and SonarQube, ensuring high code quality, security and automation standards.
  • Implement and optimise end-to-end delivery pipelines, including build, test, security scanning and deployment automation.
  • Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g. AI-assisted development, automation, testing, monitoring or platform optimisation).
  • Take ownership of workstreams, break down requirements into deliverable tasks, and operate independently in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
  • Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to improve developer experience, automation, reliability and deployment efficiency.
  • Proactively identify bottlenecks in build, release and operational processes and drive continuous improvement.
  • Support the delivery of a high-availability, globally distributed aviation platform through robust DevOps practices.


Tech Stack: AWS, Linux, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Jenkins, Python/Java , SonarQube


If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please apply with an updated CV or contact me on for a confidential chat.

• Ensino Médio completo;

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Pl/Sr Fullstack Developer - Java/React
description:
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Construir soluções de desenvolvimento de software com foco em catálogo;
  • Possuir visão clara de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Apoiar nas decisões técnicas e estratégicas, avaliando os riscos e impactos das soluções (resiliência, performance, escalabilidade e segurança);
  • Cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade e o trabalho em equipe, garantindo as entregas;
  • Participar da construção e validação das soluções desenvolvidas garantindo boa comunicação e clareza nos processos;
  • Trabalhar junto ao time na construção, definição e execução de cenários de testes do produto;
  • Proatividade e dinamismo para com o time, apoiando na solução de problemas de alta complexidade;
  • Estabelecer e promover práticas de desenvolvimento ágil, incentivando a colaboração, feedback contínuo e melhoria contínua;
  • Monitorar e analisar métricas de desempenho, identificando oportunidades de otimização e aprimoramento do sistema.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como desenvolvedor FullStack nas linguagens de programação (Java, Node, JavaScript, TypeScript e React.);
  • EXperiência com Spring Boot;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de arquitetura distribuídas, resilientes, escaláveis e de alta performance;
  • Experiência em modelagem, documentação e implementação de APIs;
  • Experiência em serviço de mensageria (SNS/SQS e RabbitMQ);
  • Experiência em soluções Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.);
  • Experiência com Git, Docker, Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com observabilidade de software;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de Microsserviços e Micro-Frontend;
  • Conhecimento de comunicação (Síncrona e assíncrona);
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados Oracle, Postgres, MongoDB e cache (Redis);
  • Conhecimento de padrões de qualidade (Pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, automação de testes).
  • Conhecimento com desenvolvimento utilizando Inteligência Artificial.
  • Ensino superior em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas da Informação ou áreas correlatas.


Diferencial :

  • Conhecimento em Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento com Amazon Q;
  • Conhecimento com desenvolvimento utilizando ADK do Google para desenvolvimento de agents;
  • Vivência em práticas ágeis como Scrum.
