title: GenAI Solution Architect
description:
GenAI Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time


In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.


  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Lead Software Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.


This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | About You

As a Lead Software Engineer, you are responsible for driving the technical vision behind scalable, modern applications while guiding a high‑performing engineering team. You’re someone who thrives at the intersection of architecture, hands‑on development, and mentorship, balancing strategic decision‑making with a passion for building exceptional software. You enjoy shaping engineering standards, elevating team capabilities, and making thoughtful choices that influence long-term product success. You’re motivated by solving complex technical challenges and creating environments where engineers can do their best work.


Lead Software Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable applications using .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or React.
  • Define engineering standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines for the development team.
  • Architect and maintain secure, high‑availability cloud-based systems optimized for performance.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure alignment between technical solutions and business goals.
  • Mentor engineers, fostering continuous learning, quality craftsmanship, and knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to quality, security, and maintainability standards.
  • Solve advanced technical challenges and influence decisions related to architecture and technology stack selection.


Lead Software Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with advanced proficiency in .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular or React).
  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and collaborating effectively across functions.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern web development standards.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing applications on AWS or other major cloud platforms.
  • Deep understanding of system architecture, design patterns, and scalable application principles.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

title: Android Developer | Specialist
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar como referência técnica transversal em Android, com foco em Kotlin, apoiando múltiplos squads na concepção e implementação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e acessíveis;
  • Identificar proativamente gaps técnicos, riscos de qualidade ou oportunidades de inovação, propondo, priorizando e liderando iniciativas de melhoria com autonomia;
  • Revisar, alinhar e evoluir arquiteturas mobile, promovendo consistência técnica e boas práticas de acessibilidade desde o código (ex.: content descriptions, hierarquia de foco, suporte a leitores de tela);
  • Liderar iniciativas estratégicas de migração e modernização, com ênfase em Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM), Jetpack Compose e padrões como MVI, do desenho à entrega e adoção;
  • Estruturar e evoluir a estratégia de testes mobile, definindo níveis apropriados (unitários, integração, instrumentados, E2E), escolhendo tecnologias (JUnit, Espresso, Compose Testing, etc.) e garantindo cobertura eficaz e manutenível;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de clean code, engenharia de qualidade e acessibilidade como parte do ciclo de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar na definição, padronização e otimização de pipelines de CI/CD para mobile (Bitrise, GitHub Actions, etc.), integrando testes automatizados e validações de acessibilidade;
  • Avaliar, validar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias que tragam vantagem competitiva, inovação e melhoria na experiência do usuário, incluindo soluções que ampliem inclusão digital;
  • Atuar como multiplicador(a) de conhecimento, mentorando desenvolvedores em temas como testabilidade, acessibilidade e arquitetura sustentável;
  • Monitorar métricas de performance, estabilidade, cobertura de testes e conformidade com diretrizes de acessibilidade.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Android com Kotlin;
  • Conhecimento prático em Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM);
  • Domínio de Jetpack Compose e arquiteturas modernas como MVI;
  • Vivência com engenharia de software de alto nível: Clean Architecture, SOLID, modularização e testabilidade como princípio de design;
  • Experiência em estruturação de estratégias de teste, desde a definição da pirâmide até a escolha e implementação de frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Espresso, Compose Testing, etc.);
  • Conhecimento técnico em acessibilidade no Android: capacidade de estruturar layouts e componentes acessíveis, validar com ferramentas e integrar checks no processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD para mobile (ex.: Bitrise, GitHub Actions, Jenkins);
  • Habilidade comprovada em revisão de código, definição de padrões técnicos e governança de stack;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de performance (ex.: Firebase Performance Monitor).






Não possui todos os requisitos para a vaga?


Está tudo bem! Na Compass UOL, estimulamos o desenvolvimento contínuo de novos talentos e transformamos desafios em oportunidades.

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions

title: Product Owner
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Organizar junto as áreas, o desenvolvimento dos produtos e serviços alinhados à estratégia do negócio, com o objetivo de definir e priorizar os requisitos do produto e garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades dos usuários e do negócio. Atuar como um representante dos stakeholders (partes interessadas) e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento para garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades do cliente e do negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.


This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.


The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies


Key Responsibilities :

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Kubernetes engineering, platform engineering, or cloud-native infrastructure roles.
  • Hands-on experience with some Kubernetes distributions (RKE2, AKS, EKS, GKE, VMware Tanzu , or upstream).
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana
  • Experience with OpenLens and other K8s management tools
  • Strong understanding of container orchestration, container runtimes, registries , and image security.
  • Expertise with infrastructure automation and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, FluxCD/ArgoCD, Helm ).
  • Experience with Linux system administration and OS-level troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of networking concepts (CNI, load balancers, service mesh, DNS, ingress/egress).
  • Experience with CSI persistent storage solutions and cluster storage migrations.

  • Ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).
  • Experience with GKE and enterprise virtualization platforms.
  • Experience designing Kubernetes platforms for AI/GPU workloads.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*

  • Great work environment

title: Snowflake Architect
description:
Job Title: Snowflake Architect

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract Length: 6 months


CloudHive is your North America and LATAM Snowflake-focused staffing partner. We help accelerate Snowflake adoption and maximize the value of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud by delivering experienced, on-demand Snowflake contractors and specialized talent acquisition services.


We are seeking an experienced Snowflake Architect for a 6-month contract supporting a key client's data migration project. You'll design and implement scalable architectures to migrate legacy systems to Snowflake, ensuring seamless data pipelines, optimization, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Architect and lead Snowflake migration, including schema design, ETL processes, and integration with tools like dbt, Fivetran, or Matillion.
  • Optimize performance, data loading, and query efficiency using Snowflake features (e.g., clustering, materialized views, and resource monitors).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define migration strategies, handle data quality checks, and implement governance best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards (e.g., role-based access control) during the migration.


Requirements:


  • 5+ years of experience as a Snowflake Architect or similar role, with proven expertise in large-scale data migrations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Snowflake SQL, Snowpark, and integration with cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Hands-on experience with data modeling, warehousing, and tools like dbt
  • Snowflake certification (e.g., SnowPro Core/Advanced Architect) preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills for stakeholder collaboration.


Please get in touch for more information. Strictly no third parties.

title: 11100 - Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce Sênior/Especialista altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade, com foco no desenvolvimento, customização e sustentação de soluções na plataforma Salesforce, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução técnica e a entrega de valor ao negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio avançado em Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce e SOQL;
  • Experiência prática com Salesforce DX, Git, pipelines de CI/CD e gerenciamento de pacotes;
  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas declarativas da plataforma, como Flow, Process Builder, Validation Rules e Permission Sets;
  • Experiência comprovada em integrações de sistemas via APIs REST e SOAP;
  • Conhecimento em autenticação OAuth 2.0 e utilização de Named Credentials;
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura multi-org, gerenciamento de ambientes sandbox e estratégias de versionamento de código;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados, incluindo frameworks de testes e uso de Jest para LWC;
  • Domínio dos módulos Sales Cloud e Service Cloud;
  • Experiência prática em gerenciamento e carga de dados utilizando Data Loader ou Workbench.


Desejáveis:

  • Certificações Salesforce.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e liderar soluções técnicas na plataforma Salesforce, utilizando Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e recursos declarativos;
  • Atuar desde a análise de requisitos até a entrega em produção, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Implementar funcionalidades customizadas e avaliar a melhor abordagem entre código e configurações declarativas;
  • Modelar objetos, campos e relacionamentos no Salesforce Data Model;
  • Configurar e manter workflows, Process Builder, Flows e validações de dados;
  • Integrar o Salesforce com sistemas externos por meio de APIs REST e SOAP;
  • Utilizar Named Credentials e Auth Providers para integrações seguras;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de testes unitários com alta cobertura, revisão de código e aplicação de design patterns alinhados ao Salesforce;
  • Realizar deploys controlados utilizando Salesforce DX;
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Atuar como referência técnica, orientando e apoiando desenvolvedores menos experientes.


✔️Contratação : CLT ou PJ

✔️Modelo de trabalho : 100% Remoto

title: Sénior C++ Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • +6 years significant experience with C++ (preferably C++11 or later);
  • Experience using GNU/Linux for development, shell scripting, and basic administration;
  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming languages and software architectures;
  • Solid understanding of distributed software architectures;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • C1 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor React + IA Sênior - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da vaga

-CLT + Benefícios

-Modelo de atuação: Remoto


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

1. Desenvolvimento Front-end Avançado

- Desenvolver aplicações front-end robustas utilizando React (e frameworks como Next.js).

- Criar componentes reutilizáveis, performáticos e acessíveis.

- Atuar na gestão avançada de estado, hooks customizados e renderização otimizada.


2. Integração com Inteligência Artificial

- Integrar aplicações React com modelos de IA/LLMs, APIs de machine learning e serviços de IA.

- Implementar experiências inteligentes (ex: chatbots, assistentes, recomendações, automações).

- Trabalhar com prompt engineering, embeddings, streaming de respostas e UX conversacional.


3. Performance, Qualidade e Experiência do Usuário

- Garantir alta performance da aplicação (Core Web Vitals, otimizações de render).

- Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e e2e).

- Garantir boas práticas de acessibilidade (a11y) e experiência do usuário.


4. Segurança e Boas Práticas

- Implementar práticas seguras no consumo de APIs, autenticação e autorização.

- Garantir uso responsável de dados em fluxos que envolvem IA.

- Prevenir vazamentos de dados e comportamentos inesperados em features inteligentes.


5. Colaboração e Influência Técnica

- Atuar de forma colaborativa com Backend, Produto, Design, Data e QA.

- Participar ativamente de refinamentos técnicos e decisões de implementação.

- Contribuir com code reviews, disseminando boas práticas no time.


6. Manutenibilidade e Evolução Técnica

- Refatorar código legado visando escalabilidade e legibilidade.

- Contribuir para padrões de código, documentação e componentes compartilhados.

- Avaliar e adotar novas ferramentas e práticas do ecossistema React e IA.


7. Inovação Contínua

- Acompanhar tendências em Front-end moderno, UX inteligente e IA aplicada a produtos.

- Propor melhorias técnicas, POCs e experimentações.

- Atuar como agente de inovação dentro do time.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- TDD

- Axios

- Advanced CSS

- React Router Dom

- React Hooks Form

- AWS DynamoDB

- CSS3 / SASS / STYLED COMPONENTS


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior
description:
Oportunidade de atuação em projeto — Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e Inteligência Artificial , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks. Atuamos em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes, priorizando inovação, colaboração, excelência técnica e desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais que atuam em nossos projetos.


Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto de tecnologia , junto a um de nossos clientes estratégicos, com foco no desenvolvimento de soluções Full Stack , por meio de contrato no modelo Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) . A atuação será remota , com foco em desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações escaláveis em ambiente cloud AWS.


Perfil técnico esperado:


1.Backend

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL utilizando Python (Flask) .
  • Integração de APIs com AWS Lake Formation e Amazon Redshift para processamento e consulta de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Implementação de regras de negócio e controle de acesso com AWS Cognito .
  • Atuação com AWS Lambda e API Gateway em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade em APIs.


2.Frontend

  • Desenvolvimento de interfaces ricas e interativas utilizando React e Next.js .
  • Criação de dashboards e visualizações de dados com bibliotecas como Nivo ou Recharts .
  • Integração do frontend com AWS Cognito para autenticação e gestão de sessões.
  • Consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL.
  • Garantia de responsividade e compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos.


3.Conhecimentos gerais

  • Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript .
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git ).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados e conceitos de Data Warehouse / Lakehouse (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Vivência com serviços AWS, como Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito e Amplify .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban .


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com AWS Lake Formation e/ou Amazon Redshift .
  • Conhecimento em Strapi CMS .
  • Vivência com outras bibliotecas de visualização de dados (D3.js, Plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e).


Escopo de atuação no projeto:

  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções Full Stack conforme escopo definido do projeto.
  • Definição e sustentação da arquitetura técnica das aplicações.
  • Análise e otimização de performance e escalabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Apoio técnico e orientação a profissionais com menor senioridade no contexto do projeto.
  • Contribuição na definição de padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Produção de documentação técnica e apoio à transferência de conhecimento.

Atuamos em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes, priorizando inovação, colaboração, excelência técnica e desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais que atuam em nossos projetos.


Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto de tecnologia , junto a um de nossos clientes estratégicos, com foco no desenvolvimento de soluções Full Stack , por meio de contrato no modelo Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) . A atuação será remota , com foco em desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações escaláveis em ambiente cloud AWS.


Perfil técnico esperado:


1.Backend

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL utilizando Python (Flask) .
  • Integração de APIs com AWS Lake Formation e Amazon Redshift para processamento e consulta de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Implementação de regras de negócio e controle de acesso com AWS Cognito .
  • Atuação com AWS Lambda e API Gateway em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade em APIs.


2.Frontend

  • Desenvolvimento de interfaces ricas e interativas utilizando React e Next.js .
  • Criação de dashboards e visualizações de dados com bibliotecas como Nivo ou Recharts .
  • Integração do frontend com AWS Cognito para autenticação e gestão de sessões.
  • Consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL.
  • Garantia de responsividade e compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos.


3.Conhecimentos gerais

  • Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript .
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git ).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados e conceitos de Data Warehouse / Lakehouse (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Vivência com serviços AWS, como Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito e Amplify .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban .


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com AWS Lake Formation e/ou Amazon Redshift .
  • Conhecimento em Strapi CMS .
  • Vivência com outras bibliotecas de visualização de dados (D3.js, Plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e).


Escopo de atuação no projeto:

  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções Full Stack conforme escopo definido do projeto.
  • Definição e sustentação da arquitetura técnica das aplicações.
  • Análise e otimização de performance e escalabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Apoio técnico e orientação a profissionais com menor senioridade no contexto do projeto.
  • Contribuição na definição de padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Produção de documentação técnica e apoio à transferência de conhecimento.

title: CRM Dynamics Developer | Mid/Senior
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Aplicar o conhecimento em programação e das funcionalidades do MS Dynamics, para apoiar a transformação dos processos através da customização do MS Dynamics e para fornecer suporte no encaminhamento e resolução de problemas em ambientes MS Dynamics.
  • Participar das reuniões de planejamento, priorização, reviews, retrospectivas e refinamentos, questionando ativamente o líder técnico e os consultores funcionais para esclarecer os requisitos;
  • Apoiar e capacitar os membros menos experientes;
  • Participar de discussões sobre arquitetura conceitual e soluções técnicas;
  • Manter-se informado sobre as atualizações e novos lançamentos do MS Dynamics.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em escrita de códigos para soluções do MS Dynamics, para Azure Function ou Logic App e, ocasionalmente, outros componentes da MS Power Platform;
  • Experiência em criação de fluxos complexos usando Power Automate e conectores customizados;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow e ZenDesk);
  • Experiência em clonagem de repositórios Git, pull request e resolução de conflitos de merge.







Não possui todos os requisitos para a vaga?


Está tudo bem! Na Compass UOL, estimulamos o desenvolvimento contínuo de novos talentos e transformamos desafios em oportunidades.


Informações adicionais

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
O que você fará:

Projetar e desenvolver arquiteturas de dados que suportem indicadores estratégicos, metas e engajamento.

Construir e automatizar pipelines ETL/ELT integrando sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos (Star Schema e Snowflake).

Escrever e otimizar SQL avançado (CTEs, funções de janela, ajuste de desempenho).

Implementar processamento e automação de dados usando Python.

Construir e manter plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem na AWS

Trabalhar com Amazon S3, Redshift e/ou Athena para dar suporte ao armazenamento e análise de dados

Aplicar a qualidade, governança e linhagem dos dados em todos os conjuntos de dados

Colaborar com as partes interessadas do negócio para traduzir as necessidades do negócio em conjuntos de dados analíticos

Dar suporte a ferramentas de BI e análise, como Power BI, Tableau e Looker

Garantir a conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e de governança em ambientes bancários e de fintech

Requisitos Mandatários:

Sólida experiência como engenheiro de dados.

Solida experiencia com SQL (CTEs, funções de janela, otimização de desempenho).

Experiência com modelagem analítica de dados.

Experiência prática na construção e automação de pipelines ETL/ELT.

Fortes habilidades em Python para processamento de dados e automação.

Sólida experiência com arquiteturas de dados em nuvem na AWS.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno
description:
Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar no mercado de TI como Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno , tendo como missão desenvolver e evoluir chatbots inteligentes e integrações eficientes, garantindo uma experiência conversacional de qualidade para o usuário, com foco em performance, usabilidade.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de bots e fluxos de integração, garantindo qualidade e desempenho.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas para projetos voltados a clientes.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente e segura.
  • Colaborar com PO, analistas de requisitos e outros stakeholders para atender às demandas de projetos.
  • Atender chamados para manutenção/sustentação do código.
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado, seguindo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para code reviews e boas práticas de programação.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de forma clara e detalhada.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com JavaScript e Java.
  • Integrações: Experiência com APIs REST/RESTful e serviços externos.
  • Chatbots & IA: Experiência no desenvolvimento de fluxos de chatbots, prompt engineering, e tecnologias de IA/NLP (Natural Language Processing).
  • Versionamento & DevOps: Experiência com Git e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle ). nível básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum, Kanban e uso de ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps). nível básico.
  • Arquitetura: Familiaridade com princípios de arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

  • Experiência com Banco de Dados MySQL .

title: Developer (Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora (Pl) para se unir ao nosso Time de Dev-Admin Tools para:

  • Desenvolvimento de novas features e correções de bugs, seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participação do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento de projetos de Software;
  • Auxílio ativo no refinamento de necessidades técnicas;
  • Participação dos ritos em um modelo de desenvolvimento ágil;
  • Execução de testes de desenvolvimento e auxílio ao time de QA para validação das entregas;
  • Apoio os times de Operações, Projetos e Produtos nas necessidades técnicas;
  • Apoio ao cliente em dúvidas relacionadas com a integração com os nossos produtos.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com planejamento, e estimava de desenvolvimento de Software;
  • Experiência com Java 11 e 17+, SpringBoot, APIs REST, Arquitetura de microsserviços, CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Orchestrador;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura baseada a eventos e serviços de mensageria;
  • Conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React (hooks, componentização e ciclo de vida);
  • Conhecimentos de segurança no back-end (validação de entrada, controle de acesso, OWASP Top 10).
  • Conhecimento de segurança no front-end (XSS, CSRF, CORS, armazenamento seguro de tokens);
  • Conhecimento de Spring MVC, Spring Validation e Spring Data JPA;
  • Conhecimento de responsividade;
  • Proficiência na qualidade das entregas e do funcionamento das soluções desenvolvidas como um todo;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento de código e práticas CI/CD (Git);
  • Conhecimento sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software/engenharia de software, da concepção à entrega;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e escrita de queries eficientes;
  • Conhecimento dos principais Design Patterns;
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento: SOLID, K.I.S.S, Clean Code;
  • Conhecimento de base de dados (SQL, noSql);
  • Conhecimento de testes unitários.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Experiência com testes unitários no front-end;
  • Conhecimentos em Linux para desenvolvimento e operação de aplicações;
  • Uso de mensageria (RabbitMQ);
  • Noções de Docker;
  • Conhecimento em análise e aperfeiçoamento de performance de APIs;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;

title: Senior Elixir Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking:


We’re looking for a talented and experienced Elixir Backend Developer to join our international team and help design, build, and harden our agentic contracts execution layer —the platform where autonomous/agent-driven workflows orchestrate and execute contractual logic reliably, at scale. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. You’ll work on resilient OTP services, job orchestration, stateful workflows, and observability to ensure correctness, auditability, and performance. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work


Your Role and Responsibilities:  

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.


Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies


Essential Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).


Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.


What We Offer:


  • Contract-based hiring;
  • Full-time opportunity (40 hours per week);
  • 100% remote work / home office;
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to achievements and deliverables;
  • Open and flexible time-off policy;
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment;
  • Equipment program;
  • Paid days off per year + holidays (variable) + recess days;
  • Sponsorship program for relevant courses and training.


For more information, visit:

Website:

Glassdoor:


**All DevGrid positions are open to individuals from all backgrounds (including all races, colors, nationalities, religions, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, ages, or other applicable characteristics), promoting equal opportunities and affirmative action.


If you're interested in the job opening and our mission, come join us on this journey!

Live long and prosper!

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.


Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies


Essential Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.

  • Sponsorship program for relevant courses and training.

Live long and prosper!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

  • You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross-functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost-effective and maintainable way.
  • Provide on-call support, including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • - Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • - Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • - Experience with agile development
  • - Good verbal/written communication skills


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • - Experience with a CICD development environment

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Technical Support & Implementation Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support and Implementation Specialist with 3 to 5 years of experience in technical customer support or implementation. In this role, you will successfully onboard our client's customers by simplifying and streamlining processes, leveraging the client's software as an end-to-end workflow and communications management solution. You will collaborate with sales, customer success, customer support, management, and engineering to deliver a world-class customer experience.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for yards of all sizes across the retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise, having worked with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms, to deliver reliable, high-performance services while lowering your total operating costs.Their deep understanding of operational challenges from multiple perspectives, along with their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and the implementation of cutting-edge technology, make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.


Responsibilities


  • Become a product expert and serve as the primary technical contact for both existing customers and new customer onboarding
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to inbound customer communications (phone, chats, and emails) – make sure to understand customer needs and provide feedback with a sense of urgency
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when necessary.
  • Lead comprehensive customized onboarding and enablement
  • Consult with customers on setup decisions and share best practices so they get the most from the platform
  • Integrate the product with other customer products to enable the customer to maximize value
  • Document and collaborate with the engineering and management teams regarding new features or adjustments to existing features
  • Closely monitor customer engagement, usage, and happiness before, during, and after a customer's go-live date
  • Represent the voice of the customer, providing input into core product, marketing, and sales decision-making
  • Handle a variety of issues that may arise during implementation and ongoing product use - always be ready to think on your feet!
  • Deliver excellent customer experiences


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 3 to 5 years of implementation or technical customer support experience in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) or software company
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as Zendesk and Hubspot (Hubspot preferred)
  • Ability to accurately describe issues, collect applicable documentation, and operate as a liaison between the product team and the customer
  • Prior experience documenting new features and getting your requests prioritized into Sprints
  • Proven track record of working with multiple stakeholders – customers, company management, and engineering
  • Ability to handle front-line customer/user communications all the way up to executive-level conversations – Talk tech/product with customers and talk business value with executive management
  • Project management experience – must have attention to detail and proven ability to track, prioritize, and follow through on action items without encouragement from others
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, technical engineering, or Information Technology
  • Experience working with US-based companies
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

  • Start: ASAP
